1	package renderer
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"
7	
8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
9		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"
10	
11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
16		buf *bytes.Buffer
17	}
18	
19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
23		}
24	}
25	
26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
28		r.buf.Reset()
29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
30		return r.buf.String()
31	}
32	
33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
35		switch n := node.(type) {
36		case *gast.Document:
37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
38	
39		case *gast.Paragraph:
40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
43			}
44	
45		case *gast.Text:
46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
47			segment := n.Segment
48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
53			}
54	
55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
59	
60		case *gast.Emphasis:
61			symbol := "*"
62			if n.Level == 2 {
63				symbol = "**"
64			}
65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
68	
69		case *gast.Link:
70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
78			}
79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
80	
81		case *gast.AutoLink:
82			url := n.URL(source)
83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
85				r.buf.Write(url)
86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
87			} else {
88				r.buf.Write(url)
89			}
90	
91		case *gast.Image:
92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
100			}
101			r.buf.WriteString(")")
102	
103		case *gast.Heading:
104			r.buf.WriteString(strings.Repeat("#", n.Level))
105			r.buf.WriteByte(' ')
106			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
107			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
108				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
109			}
110	
111		case *gast.CodeBlock, *gast.FencedCodeBlock:
112			r.renderCodeBlock(n, source)
113	
114		case *gast.Blockquote:
115			// Render each child line with "> " prefix
116			r.renderBlockquote(n, source, depth)
117			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
118				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
119			}
120	
121		case *gast.List:
122			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
123			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
124				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
125			}
126	
127		case *gast.ListItem:
128			r.renderListItem(n, source, depth)
129	
130		case *gast.ThematicBreak:
131			r.buf.WriteString("---")
132			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
133				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
134			}
135	
136		case *east.Strikethrough:
137			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
138			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
139			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
140	
141		case *east.TaskCheckBox:
142			if n.IsChecked {
143				r.buf.WriteString("[x] ")
144			} else {
145				r.buf.WriteString("[ ] ")
146			}
147	
148		case *east.Table:
149			r.renderTable(n, source)
150			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
151				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
152			}
153	
154		// Custom Memos nodes
155		case *mast.TagNode:
156			r.buf.WriteByte('#')
157			r.buf.Write(n.Tag)
158	
159		case *mast.MentionNode:
160			r.buf.WriteByte('@')
161			r.buf.Write(n.Username)
162	
163		default:
164			// For unknown nodes, try to render children
165			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
166		}
167	}
168	
169	// renderChildren renders all children of a node.
170	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderChildren(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
171		child := node.FirstChild()
172		for child != nil {
173			r.renderNode(child, source, depth+1)
174			child = child.NextSibling()
175		}
176	}
177	
178	// renderCodeBlock renders a code block.
179	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderCodeBlock(node gast.Node, source []byte) {
180		if fenced, ok := node.(*gast.FencedCodeBlock); ok {
181			// Fenced code block with language
182			r.buf.WriteString("```")
183			if lang := fenced.Language(source); len(lang) > 0 {
184				r.buf.Write(lang)
185			}
186			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
187	
188			// Write all lines
189			lines := fenced.Lines()
190			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
191				line := lines.At(i)
192				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
193			}
194	
195			r.buf.WriteString("```")
196			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
197				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
198			}
199		} else if codeBlock, ok := node.(*gast.CodeBlock); ok {
200			// Indented code block
201			lines := codeBlock.Lines()
202			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
203				line := lines.At(i)
204				r.buf.WriteString("    ")
205				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
206			}
207			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
208				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
209			}
210		}
211	}
212	
213	// renderBlockquote renders a blockquote with "> " prefix.
214	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderBlockquote(node *gast.Blockquote, source []byte, depth int) {
215		// Create a temporary buffer for the blockquote content
216		tempBuf := &bytes.Buffer{}
217		tempRenderer := &MarkdownRenderer{buf: tempBuf}
218		tempRenderer.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
219	
220		// Add "> " prefix to each line
221		content := tempBuf.String()
222		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), "\n")
223		for i, line := range lines {
224			r.buf.WriteString("> ")
225			r.buf.WriteString(line)
226			if i < len(lines)-1 {
227				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
228			}
229		}
230	}
231	
232	// renderListItem renders a list item with proper indentation and markers.
233	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderListItem(node *gast.ListItem, source []byte, depth int) {
234		parent := node.Parent()
235		list, ok := parent.(*gast.List)
236		if !ok {
237			r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
238			return
239		}
240	
241		// Add indentation only for nested lists
242		// Document=0, List=1, ListItem=2 (no indent), nested ListItem=3+ (indent)
243		if depth > 2 {
244			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", depth-2)
245			r.buf.WriteString(indent)
246		}
247	
248		// Add list marker
249		if list.IsOrdered() {
250			fmt.Fprintf(r.buf, "%d. ", list.Start)
251			list.Start++ // Increment for next item
252		} else {
253			r.buf.WriteString("- ")
254		}
255	
256		// Render content
257		r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
258	
259		// Add newline if there's a next sibling
260		if node.NextSibling() != nil {
261			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// renderTable renders a table in markdown format.
266	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderTable(table *east.Table, source []byte) {
267		// This is a simplified table renderer
268		// A full implementation would need to handle alignment, etc.
269		r.renderChildren(table, source, 0)
270	}

66		// Shared authorizer: one source of truth for authentication and anonymous-access
67		// policy, used by both the gRPC-Gateway middleware and the Connect interceptor.
68		authorizer := NewAuthorizer(s.Store, s.Secret, s.Profile)
69		gatewayAuthMiddleware := func(next runtime.HandlerFunc) runtime.HandlerFunc {
70			return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, pathParams map[string]string) {
71				ctx := r.Context()
72	
73				// The RPC method name is set by grpc-gateway after routing. When it can't be
74				// determined, skip the policy check and let the service layer handle visibility.
75				rpcMethod, ok := runtime.RPCMethod(ctx)
76				authHeader := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
77	
78				result := authorizer.Authenticate(ctx, authHeader)
79				if ok {
80					if err := authorizer.CheckAccess(ctx, rpcMethod, result); err != nil {
81						http.Error(w, `{"code": 16, "message": "authentication required"}`, http.StatusUnauthorized)
82						return
83					}
84				}
85	
86				// Apply the identity to the context (no-op for permitted anonymous requests).
87				if result != nil {
88					r = r.WithContext(auth.ApplyToContext(ctx, result))
89				}
90	
91				next(w, r, pathParams)
92			}
93		}
94	
95		// Create gRPC-Gateway mux with auth middleware.
96		gwMux := runtime.NewServeMux(
97			runtime.WithMiddlewares(gatewayAuthMiddleware),
98		)
99		if err := v1pb.RegisterInstanceServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
100			return err
101		}
102		if err := v1pb.RegisterAuthServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
103			return err
104		}
105		if err := v1pb.RegisterUserServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
106			return err
107		}
108		if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
109			return err
110		}
111		if err := v1pb.RegisterAttachmentServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
112			return err
113		}
114		if err := v1pb.RegisterAIServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
115			return err
116		}
117		if err := v1pb.RegisterShortcutServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
118			return err
119		}
120		if err := v1pb.RegisterIdentityProviderServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
121			return err
122		}
123		gwGroup := echoServer.Group("")
124		// Register SSE endpoint with same CORS as rest of /api/v1.
125		RegisterSSERoutes(gwGroup, s.SSEHub, s.Store, s.Secret)
126		handler := echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(gwMux, maxAPIRequestBytes))
127	
128		gwGroup.Any("/api/v1/*", handler)
129		gwGroup.Any("/file/*", handler)
130	
131		// Connect handlers for browser clients (replaces grpc-web).
132		logStacktraces := s.Profile.Demo
133		connectInterceptors := connect.WithInterceptors(
134			NewMetadataInterceptor(), // Convert HTTP headers to gRPC metadata first
135			NewLoggingInterceptor(logStacktraces),
136			NewRecoveryInterceptor(logStacktraces),
137			NewAuthInterceptor(authorizer),
138		)
139		connectMux := http.NewServeMux()
140		connectHandler := NewConnectServiceHandler(s)
141		connectHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers(connectMux, connectInterceptors, connect.WithReadMaxBytes(maxAPIRequestBytes))
142	
143		connectGroup := echoServer.Group("")
144		connectGroup.Any("/memos.api.v1.*", echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(connectMux, maxAPIRequestBytes)))
145	
146		return nil
147	}

1	package parser
2	
3	import (
4		"unicode"
5		"unicode/utf8"
6	
7		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
8		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/parser"
9		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/text"
10	
11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	const (
15		// MaxTagLength defines the maximum number of runes allowed in a tag.
16		MaxTagLength = 100
17	)
18	
19	type tagParser struct{}
20	
21	// NewTagParser creates a new inline parser for #tag syntax.
22	func NewTagParser() parser.InlineParser {
23		return &tagParser{}
24	}
25	
26	// Trigger returns the characters that trigger this parser.
27	func (*tagParser) Trigger() []byte {
28		return []byte{'#'}
29	}
30	
31	// isValidTagRune checks if a Unicode rune is valid in a tag.
32	// Uses Unicode categories for proper international character support.
33	func isValidTagRune(r rune) bool {
34		// Allow Unicode letters (any script: Latin, CJK, Arabic, Cyrillic, etc.)
35		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
36			return true
37		}
38	
39		// Allow Unicode digits
40		if unicode.IsNumber(r) {
41			return true
42		}
43	
44		// Allow emoji and symbols (So category: Symbol, Other)
45		// This includes emoji, which are essential for social media-style tagging
46		if unicode.IsSymbol(r) {
47			return true
48		}
49	
50		// Allow marks (non-spacing, spacing combining, enclosing)
51		// This covers variation selectors (e.g. VS16 \uFE0F) and combining marks (e.g. Keycap \u20E3, accents)
52		if unicode.IsMark(r) {
53			return true
54		}
55	
56		// Allow Zero Width Joiner (ZWJ) for emoji sequences
57		if r == '\u200D' {
58			return true
59		}
60	
61		// Allow specific ASCII symbols for tag structure
62		// Underscore: word separation (snake_case)
63		// Hyphen: word separation (kebab-case)
64		// Forward slash: hierarchical tags (category/subcategory)
65		// Ampersand: compound tags (science&tech)
66		if r == '_' || r == '-' || r == '/' || r == '&' {
67			return true
68		}
69	
70		return false
71	}
72	
73	// Parse parses #tag syntax using Unicode-aware validation.
74	// Tags support international characters and follow these rules:
75	//   - Must start with # followed by valid tag characters
76	//   - Valid characters: Unicode letters, Unicode digits, underscore (_), hyphen (-), forward slash (/)
77	//   - Maximum length: 100 runes (Unicode characters)
78	//   - Stops at: whitespace, punctuation, or other invalid characters
79	func (*tagParser) Parse(_ gast.Node, block text.Reader, _ parser.Context) gast.Node {
80		line, _ := block.PeekLine()
81	
82		// Must start with #
83		if len(line) == 0 || line[0] != '#' {
84			return nil
85		}
86	
87		// Check if it's a heading (## or space after #)
88		if len(line) > 1 {
89			if line[1] == '#' {
90				// It's a heading (##), not a tag
91				return nil
92			}
93			if line[1] == ' ' {
94				// Space after # - heading or just a hash
95				return nil
96			}
97		} else {
98			// Just a lone #
99			return nil
100		}
101	
102		// Parse tag using UTF-8 aware rune iteration
103		tagStart := 1
104		pos := tagStart
105		runeCount := 0
106	
107		for pos < len(line) {
108			r, size := utf8.DecodeRune(line[pos:])
109	
110			// Stop at invalid UTF-8
111			if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
112				break
113			}
114	
115			// Validate character using Unicode categories
116			if !isValidTagRune(r) {
117				break
118			}
119	
120			// Enforce max length (by rune count, not byte count)
121			runeCount++
122			if runeCount > MaxTagLength {
123				break
124			}
125	
126			pos += size
127		}
128	
129		// Must have at least one character after #
130		if pos <= tagStart {
131			return nil
132		}
133	
134		// Extract tag (without #)
135		tagName := line[tagStart:pos]
136	
137		// Make a copy of the tag name
138		tagCopy := make([]byte, len(tagName))
139		copy(tagCopy, tagName)
140	
141		// Advance reader
142		block.Advance(pos)
143	
144		// Create node
145		node := &mast.TagNode{
146			Tag: tagCopy,
147		}
148	
149		return node
150	}
